main_text.p: שְׁלִיָּה, שַׁלְיוּא Ch. Tranquillus, masc. Jobi 16.12. Tranquilla, foem. Zach.7.7. Substantive, Tranquillitas, otium, Dan.4.24. & adverbial. Quietè, tranquillè.
שְׁלִיוּתָא Ch. Tranquillitas, quies, otiū, Psal.122.6. & 73.1.
שְׁלִיוּתָא Chal. Idem, וּשְׁלִיוּתִיהּ דְּעָרָן Et tranquillitatem Hedenis, Gen.49.1. in in T.Hier.Jon.habet טְלִנִיתָא.

שְׁלִיא, Ch. Syr. Idem, 2.Sam.3.27. Matth.8.26. Lucæ 8.24. Item Ch. Repentinus casus, Repentina vastitas, Vastitas tumultuosa, quòd ea quæ derepentè accidunt, tranquillè & tacitè quasi adveniant, Proverb.1.26. & 3.25. Psalm.35.8. juxta alios, Caligo, obscuritas, tenebræ: מִן שְׁלִיא & בִּשְׁלִיא Subitò, repentè, derepentè. Sic Syr. ܣܠܝܐ Actor.2.2. & ahsq; ܣܠܝܐ Luc.2.13. & Act.9.3. Vide & infrà in שְׁלָהִי.
שְׁלִיאִית Ch. Subitò, repentè, derepentè, Prov.7.22.
Syr. Cessatio, Intermisio, Sine intermisione, indesinenter, 1. ad Thess.5.17. ad Roman. 1. 9.
שְׁלוּת, שְׁלוּתָא Ch. Error, erratum, delictum, ignorantia, & cum הַשְׁלָה Dan.3.29. Pl. שְׁלוּיִן, שְׁלוּיְתָא Errores, Psalm.19.13.
שַׁלְהָב Pahel Ch. Inflammare, accendere, succendere, comburere: Inflammari, ardere: Idem quod
